forms.headline: Color, engineered
forms.body: ROSON's color led treatment chair, built on a 12 mm carbon structural steel frame and finished in the color the clinic chooses rather than the one the catalog allows.

whoItIsFor.headline: Design led clinics and first practices

Women led and design conscious clinics
Pediatric and family friendly clinics
Premium aesthetic and cosmetic practices
Multi chair clinics with operatory personalities
Boutique design led private practices

features.headline: From the product page
features.body: The feature list on the existing page, unchanged. The full specification table stays reachable below this beat.
bullets: 12 mm carbon structural steel frame with a 150 kg patient load
